title: Build Hero Section with Interactive Live Frame Switcher Island
description: Create the flagship Hero Section featuring editorial typography, dual CTAs, and a high-fidelity interactive Client Component that allows instant switching between frame finishes, mat widths, and room contexts.
acceptanceCriteria: Hero layout features high-impact editorial headline, subheadline, and primary/secondary CTAs
Interactive Live Frame Switcher Client Component allows instant toggling between 5 frame materials (American Walnut, Antique Brass, Matte Black, White Oak, Florentine Gold)
Users can toggle mat margins (No Mat, 2-inch Classic, 3-inch Gallery) with real-time inner bevel shadow recalculation
Context switcher toggles between Neutral Studio Wall and Styled Living Room Backdrop
Frame selection state is preserved and ready to pass into customizer checkout flow

steps.description: Define frame mock data and moulding types
steps.details: Create lib/constants/frames.ts with rich moulding specs, wood textures, and color mappings.
Create components/hero/live-frame-switcher.tsx with smooth CSS transitions, bevel shadows, and active state pills.
Create components/hero/hero-container.tsx combining copy, trust triggers, and the switcher island.

steps.description: Verify live switcher interaction in browser
steps.details: Execute Playwright interaction test toggling each frame finish and capture screenshots.
